   **Баги и стабильность.**
      24 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 8 июн. 2026 г. - 5 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _lupercaia_, 25 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "i really loved it first, but then the app started working worse and worse. first, some blocks that i set up started duplicating - meaning you had to unblock it twice. then some blocks started showing up on wrong times - like block that’s scheduled for weekdays on Saturday. Then unblocking the blocks became very easy and short for whatever reason?? My final straw was just now when I received the very same push notification frim them TEN TIMES IN A ROW. It used to be a great app, but it’s broken now."
            2. _S.ley1'_, 4 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
            3. _Wvoqfent_, 26 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "After the latest update, the app is very slow and does not block the apps even when rules are active. Please fix it!"
